title: Surveillance
paragraphs: Eventually, Itsuki also turned to face us with that self-righteous look.
“The interrogation comes later.”
“Why!? That was theft! It’s a crime! We should catch her red-handed!”
“That’s impossible. She’s this country’s princess, and tomorrow, Father—no, Naofumi—will be falsely accused of being a rapist and dragged to the castle.”
“What!?”
“The mastermind is her. The perpetrator is the pig, and that pig will cry fake tears, claiming to be the victim of assault. How does that look to those who don’t know the truth?”
“A p-pig? Well, I can’t say I don’t get where you’re coming from…”
My mouth had reached its limit after explaining this all over again. Ren started thinking it through.
“Um… who is that person…?”
Itsuki, looking dumbfounded at the Queen’s words, turned his gaze to me.
Ugh… talking to her disgusts me, but I’ll endure it. Itsuki wouldn’t like it, and if Ren is discovered, it will arouse suspicion.
“Heroes, please take these robes.”
The Queen handed robes to Ren and Itsuki.
“Kitamura-sama, I’m counting on you.”
“Leave it to me!”
Thus, we discreetly headed to the tavern and lured out the Crimson Swine. Just like last time, she came waddling over.
“Bubububu…”
“Indeed. Haha, yes.”
Every time I wonder… why do the pig and her kind think they’re having a conversation just by giving empty responses?

Is it that? I recall Father once muttering that pigs think of men as ATMs. Yes, that must be it. Conversations between pigs and humans don’t align. It’s as if they expect men to operate mechanically as programmed. In that regard, Filo is amusing. If I were to give her empty responses like that, she’d keep asking “Why? Why?” and eventually pout. Well, I usually give in before that happens, but in the first world, Father didn’t budge. The previous Father deflected questions by asking more questions in return. Either way, it shows how skilled he is at handling Filo. The Crimson Swine proudly handed me the incriminating chainmail.
Fufufufu…
“Bu?”
“A-Are you sure?”
“Bubububu!”

I suppressed my laughter as I pretended to accept the stolen item while enduring the nauseating sight of the pig’s smile. The Crimson Swine left, satisfied. Ren, Itsuki, and the Queen, who was barely containing her rage, watched the whole thing unfold from hiding. Ren and Itsuki seemed to be trembling, trying to stay unnoticed. I casually left the tavern and headed for the back alley. Of course, I cast a spell to flush out anyone hiding while preventing any sound from leaking. Ren and Itsuki quickly followed, as if they were running from the Queen.
“We’ve secured the evidence. At dawn, she’ll come to wake me up at my inn.”
“No… this can’t be… it’s actually true… What is going on?”
“Why is everything happening exactly as you said? Is this some kind of play? Or a prank? No, I can’t imagine you’d go through all this just to fool us.”
“More importantly… who exactly is that person?”
“Then allow me to introduce her. She is the true ruler of Melromarc. The Queen.”
“Huh?”
I introduced the Queen to Ren and Itsuki. The Queen pulled back her hood and gave a slight bow.
“Nice to meet you. I am Mirelia Q. Melromarc, the ruler of this kingdom.”

Yes, that’s right. Back when Father was still here, I had asked the Queen where she had been when we were first summoned. It was quite the ordeal to bring her here. After shaking off the pigs, I used the portal to warp to where the Queen was. At first, I thought the Queen was somewhere around Faubrey, but she was actually engaged in diplomacy in a country a little further away near Faubrey. Apparently, she was staying there to witness the summoning of the heroes. Although I used the portal, the castle was a bit further away. Since I don’t have everything mapped out, and considering that she was moving around by the hour, taking the nearest location caused a significant loss of time.
“Excuse me!”
“Who are you!?”
I approached the castle where the Queen was staying that day from the front. The castle guards blocked my path.
“I am the Spear Hero, one of the Four Holy Heroes summoned yesterday. I know that the Queen of Melromarc is here.”
“The Spear Hero? Stop spouting nonsense!”

Apparently, the news that the Four Holy Heroes had been summoned together had not yet been acknowledged by the world. Or rather, it seemed like Faubrey had just discovered it and was in the process of notifying other countries. So, it’s no wonder they were behind on this information.
“Do you still not believe me?”
To prove that I was a hero, I demonstrated the ability to change the shape of my weapon at will.
“Hmph, that’s nothing special. Impersonating a hero is a serious crime! Arrest him!”

A group of soldiers emerged and surrounded me. They don’t believe me… how troublesome. Impersonating a hero is indeed a crime. They probably thought there was no way the real one would show up. I want to tell them to just report it to their superiors already.
“Be quiet and surrender!”
The soldiers pointed their weapons at me and tried to force my surrender, but that’s basically how it always goes.
“How annoying.”
I gripped my spear tightly and swung it. Just that created a violent gust of wind.
“Uwaaaaaaaaah!”
The soldiers were blown away by the wind of my swing.
“T-This guy! He’s strong! I don’t know what kind of magic he’s using, but if you resist the kingdom’s soldiers, you won’t get away with it!”
“If you keep this up, I’ll kill you.”
“Attack him!”
As the soldiers called for reinforcements, I reluctantly decided to use my skills.
“Aiming Lancer!”
I threw my spear high, piercing through the soldiers around me. Since killing them would be a hassle, I held back.
“Gwaaaaaaah!”
“Uwaaaaaah!”
Soldiers all around me collapsed, groaning in pain.
“Buhiieeeeeeeee!”
A pig-like pedestrian near the castle screamed. Annoying. Should I kill you too?
“Ugh… ugh…”
“D-Don’t let him enter the castle! Protect the king and the guests with your lives!”
“Oooooh!”
More and more soldiers kept pouring out. Father told me not to kill anyone and just talk to the Queen. Avoiding fatal wounds is a hassle.
“Great Whirlwind!”
I activated a skill that spun my spear around me. When the level is high, a tornado forms as an additional effect.
“Gyaaaaaaah!”
The soldiers were swept up by the tornado and sent flying.
“Dieeee!”
Even the arrows from the archers were knocked down. This is such a pain. I pressed forward into the castle without killing anyone.
“Paralyze Lance! Meteor Spear!”
I mowed down the soldiers pouring in as I made my way straight into the castle. For some reason, a bunch of shady-looking guys had started following behind me.
“Revolutionary reinforcements. This will be the end of the corrupt monarchy. Come, won’t you join hands with us?”
“I don’t know you.”
These guys seem fine to take down.
“Brionac X!”
“Gyaaaaah!”
I remember Father lamenting how there are always idiots who take advantage of the chaos. I’ve never seen a country improve after a coup.
“Come out already!”
“G-Get the dignitaries out of here as soon as possible! A monster is attacking!”

I don’t have much time. I need to meet with the Queen quickly. But advancing without killing anyone is incredibly tedious. To top it off, they’re trying to take me down with ritual magic. Of course, I absorbed it with Absorb.
“Stop right there. Are you the one who wishes to speak with me?”

While I was fighting off the soldiers, the Queen finally made her appearance. The soldiers cleared a path, and the Queen stepped forward. Apparently, she had been in talks with the people of this country. She said it took time because of the blame-shifting and evacuation procedures.
“I apologize for keeping you waiting. Could you please lower your weapon?”
“I came here to talk. However, it was your soldiers who refused to listen.”
Is it just my imagination, or does the Queen seem a little tense? I’m a gentleman. Father and Filo-tan told me to live sincerely, after all.
“…So, what do you need from me? First, could you tell me who you are?”
“I am one of the Four Holy Heroes, the Spear Hero, Motoyasu Kitamura. I was summoned yesterday in your country, Melromarc.”
The Queen’s expression grew severe. She was probably trying to process a truth she had no knowledge of.
“Do you not believe me?”
“…In terms of strength, I can see that you possess power befitting the legends. However, I am somewhat skeptical about the claim that our country summoned the Four Holy Heroes…”
“It’s something that will become public knowledge in a few days anyway. Your husband and that useless princess colluded with the Three Heroes Church and caused this mess.”
“Our country… I was under the impression that the Three Heroes Church was a peaceful religion…”

What a ridiculous assumption. The Three Heroes Church is the root of all evil and has never produced anything but disaster. I’ve been burned by them countless times in previous loops. They must have kept everything hidden until now.
But convincing someone that I’m looping is no easy task. However, if taking the Queen with me can shatter the conspiracy against Father, I’ll do my best.
“May I ask you some questions?”
“Ask as many as you want. But do we have that much time?”
“Then… First, Melromarc is quite far from here. How did the hero summoned just yesterday manage to get here?”
“I used the hero’s teleportation skill to warp here instantly.”
She doesn’t believe me? The Queen’s reaction was quiet.
“Next… According to legend, heroes are summoned at level 1. But judging from your strength, you’re far stronger than that. How do you explain this?”
“I retained the levels I gained in a similar world, which is why I’m stronger than the other heroes right after being summoned.”

This explanation is easier to believe than trying to convince her that I’m looping. If I had some sort of secret code or proof, that would be ideal, but everything can be verified with a little investigation, making it hard to offer definitive proof. Of course, I already know the secret code from the Queen herself.
“I see… Then, Kitamura-dono, the Spear Hero, would you accompany me to Faubrey and attend a meeting?”

“I don’t have time for that. Your husband, that useless princess, and the Three Heroes Church are conspiring to frame the Shield Hero. They’re even plotting to have the other heroes kill him. Can we afford to wait?”
“I will order my subordinates to stop them.”
“Are you capable of that?”
At my confident demeanor, the Queen opened her fan and fell into deep thought. She’s one of the more reasonable queens. She should be able to grasp the danger posed by Trash’s reckless actions.
“By the way, Queen, what you were considering this morning was whether to give the new Filolial encyclopedia and research materials to your daughter—Melty, correct?”
The Queen’s eyes widened.
“Why do you know that? Are you suggesting that the Spear Hero possesses mind-reading abilities? No, that’s not it.”
“…Very well. Since you know that much, what is it you want from me?”
“I want you to accompany me for one night and witness firsthand the events unfolding in Melromarc.”
I casually sent a party invitation to the Queen. After some thought, she turned around.
“Summon Melty. We will depart shortly.”
After a short while, the princess arrived.
“Mother, what is going on?”
“It seems this man is the real Spear Hero. Either way, to avoid causing trouble for this country, we must act as hostages.”
“M-Mother…!”
The princess looked quite worried. This isn’t such a bad thing, so calm down. Filo-tan would be anxious otherwise.
“Once you accept the invitation, we’ll use the portal to warp to Melromarc.”
“Kitamura-dono, is this all the preparation we need?”
“Yes… but if possible, I’d prefer for you to keep a low profile. Wear a robe to conceal your status.”
“Understood. I will arrange it.”
“Also, bring two extra robes.”
“Understood.”
The Queen and the princess donned robes and accepted my invitation.
“Then, Portal Spear!”

After leaving the castle, I used the skill to bring the Queen and the princess to Melromarc. Now, the only thing left was to ensure that the Queen properly witnessed everything happening in Melromarc.
